question: Name the suicidal bags of the cell.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lysosomes.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

**Lysosomes **are called **suicidal bags** of the cell.

 
• This is because the lysosomes are organelles that digest materials taken up by the cell from the outside.
 
• If the lysosomes burst by any chance, the digestive enzyme leaks into the cell's insides.&l
